import sys

def solve():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    mod = 1000000007
    dp0 = [[0] * (n + 1) for _ in range(n + 1)]
    dp1 = [[0] * (n + 1) for _ in range(n + 1)]

    for ij in range(2 * n, -1, -1):
        for i in range(0, n + 1):
            j = ij - i
            if j < 0 or j > n:
                continue
            if j > i:
                continue
            if i == n and j == n:
                continue

            if i == j:
                dp0[i][j] = max(1 + dp1[i + 1][j], dp0[i + 1][j])
            elif i == n:
                dp0[i][j] = max(1 + dp1[i][j + 1], dp0[i][j + 1])
            else:
                v1 = (dp0[i + 1][j] + dp0[i][j + 1]) % mod
                v2 = (1 + dp1[i + 1][j] + dp0[i][j + 1]) % mod
                v3 = (1 + dp0[i + 1][j] + dp1[i][j + 1]) % mod
                dp0[i][j] = max(v1, v2, v3)

            if i == j:
                dp1[i][j] = dp0[i + 1][j]
            elif i == n:
                dp1[i][j] = dp0[i][j + 1]
            else:
                dp1[i][j] = (dp0[i + 1][j] + dp0[i][j + 1]) % mod

    print(dp0[0][0] % mod)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
